chapter: The China offer, wedding and Shanghai
title: Opening at a new club and Langston Hughes
summary: He soon opened at the Casa Nova club with a publicity line proud of him, and recalls young Langston Hughes visiting.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Pretty bad. But see we opened very shortly in another club and this club says we proudly announce Buck Clayton. Because he didn't care if they were going to.....
What was the name of this other club?
You know I have to look in my book to find it out. But it was a French name. It had a French name. (SEE MR. CLAYTON'S NOTES) [Casa Nova Club]
Oh we were there about six or eight months. We had done quite a bit at the Canidrome. We had done about eight or ten months.
I see. So you built up a big local following?
Yes, we did. You know who
was a youngster over there who used to come and see me was Langston Hughes.
He was a young man just learning to write.
